visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a back view of a female drummer with short black hair, wearing a white long-sleeved shirt, sitting behind a professional drum kit in an outdoor urban plaza. She is playing a fast-paced rhythm. In the background, a large crowd of people sits and stands on green artificial turf, watching her. A building with a 'SNOOPY' sign and a white inflatable dragon are visible in the distance under bright natural daylight. (2) As the music continues, a group of young children suddenly run from the crowd onto the green turf in front of the drum kit. They begin to dance, jump, and crouch in sync with the drum beats. The drummer remains focused, playing with high energy and looking toward the dancing children. The camera pans slightly to capture the growing excitement of the crowd. (3) The performance concludes with a final flourish on the drums. The drummer stops playing, picks up a handheld microphone, and turns to the crowd. The audience is seen cheering and clapping, while the children who were dancing remain on the turf nearby. The scene is filled with vibrant energy and warm interaction between the performer and the audience.

The sound of children's voices is heard clearly during this transition, adding a playful layer to the ending.
